adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb the error-path examples (e.g., `it "is 404 without an embed_url"` and others) assert only `response.should_not be_success`, which will pass for any non-2xx response and does not verify the stated contract ("is 404"). Given `EmbedController#best` calls `params.require(:embed_url)`, a change that turned the behavior into a 400/500 could still satisfy `should_not be_success`, so the tests provide weak/ambiguous coverage of the intended error semantics. This is a test robustness issue, not an application defect proven by the diff.
